official_definition: Grand Bombardment (When Attacks) You can reveal two cards from your Deck. For each "Z"/"Steel"-named card among them, put a core from the void to any Red Grandwalker Nexus you control, and send an opposing Life to the Reserve. Those cards are added to your hand.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Grand Bombardment] or [Grand Bombardment: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Grand Bombardment]", "give [Grand Bombardment]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
